en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for southern waters and islands
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 2.03pm, later extended to 4pm, as isolated storms were expected over Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and nearby waters.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 2.03pm on Tuesday, initially valid until 3pm and later extended to 4pm, forecasting isolated thunderstorms over southern waters and islands as well as parts of Hong Kong Island and Kowloon.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter, to leave the water and avoid outdoor swimming or other water sports, and not to stand on high ground or near conductive objects, trees or masts.

Earlier in the day a separate Thunderstorm Warning had covered the eastern New Territories. The northeast monsoon was gradually affecting the coast of eastern Guangdong, with upper-air disturbances bringing showers to the region.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料南部水域及島嶼有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 警告於下午2時03分發出，其後延長至下午4時；天文台預料香港島、九龍及附近水域有局部雷暴。
body: 香港天文台於周二下午2時03分發出雷暴警告，最初有效至下午3時，其後延長至下午4時，預料南部水域及島嶼，以及香港島和九龍部分地區有局部雷暴。
天文台提醒市民，身處室外時應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿進行戶外游泳或其他水上活動，亦不要站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
同日較早前，天文台曾就新界東部發出另一個雷暴警告。一股東北季候風正逐漸影響廣東東部沿岸，與高空擾動相關的驟雨正影響廣東地區。
